description: Weekly update PRs for flake inputs and GitHub Actions. CI evaluates each PR; merging it lets comin deploy.

lockFileMaintenance.description: The nix manager only refreshes flake.lock through lock file maintenance, and it is off by default. Without this, no flake input ever updates.

packageRules.description: All flake.lock updates (nixpkgs, home-manager, sops-nix, comin) in one PR
All GitHub Actions bumps in one PR
